scenario: Two `logical`-schema bindings in the same rule LHS with a cross-pattern comparison per LLOG.11.4. Both schemas use truth-maintenance; the comparison `r.val > h.val` accesses bindings from both patterns. Pin: the rule compiles cleanly with the cross-binding test CE.
rules_ds:
schema Threshold scope logical:
    val: Float key

schema Reading scope logical:
    val: Float key

rule above_threshold:
    Threshold h
    Reading r where r.val > h.val
->
    log info "above threshold"
